==Description==
'''Gift''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that was obtained upon reaching Rank 15 on the [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Krampus' Revenge Season Pass|Krampus' Revenge Season]]. It was created by CapraKinetics. The emote is looped, though will end if another player interacts with it. No music can be heard while performing the emote, and you can move while the emote is being performed.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 15 on the [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Krampus' Revenge Season Pass|Krampus' Revenge Season Pass]], which costs {{Cookies|5,000 Cookies}} or {{Robux|380}} at that rank. The total cost of buying all ranks from Rank 1 to Rank 15 is {{Robux|2,445}}.

==Interactions==
When a player is performing '''Gift''', another player may interact with them. Doing so will cause them to open the gift and its contents. The gift may have the following items inside:
*'''Lump of coal''': The player looks displeased, drops it, then starts crying.
*'''Gingerbread cookie''': The player eats it.
*'''Candy cane''': The player licks it.
*'''Fruitcake''': The player holds it briefly, then throws it away.

==Trivia==
*This emote loosely resembles the [[w:c:robloxarsenal:Taunts|Gift For You]] taunt from ''Arsenal''.
